schema:name: Navarro et al. (2024) Iron Meteorite Spot v1
schema:description: laicpmsTAPP instance derived from Navarro et al. 2024 (ACS ESC 8) Iron meteorites Spot analysis ns-LA-SF-ICP-MS University of Campinas (column S of LA-Q_SF-ICPMS_TAPP_v3.xlsx 'TAPP' worksheet).

schema:location.schema:name: Isotope Geology Laboratory, University of Campinas (UNICAMP), Brazil

ada:detectorConfiguration: Triple mode detector (pulse counting, analog, Faraday)
ada:laserWavelengthAndType: 193 nm ArF excimer; pulse duration 4 ns
ada:ablationSpotDurationDefault: 40 s on-sample ablation (after 20 s background measurement)
ada:carrierGasFlowRateDefault: He: 0.6 l min⁻¹ (MFC 1) + 0.7 l min⁻¹ (MFC 2) in HelEx II cell; combined with Ar makeup via T-piece near torch
ada:coolantGasFlowRateDefault: Plasma gas: 16 l min⁻¹; Auxiliary: 0.9 l min⁻¹; Nebulizer gas (from table): 1.1 l min⁻¹
ada:analysisSequenceDefault: NIST SRM 612(×3) → North Chile(×3) → unknowns(×10) → NIST SRM 612(×2) → North Chile(×2) → unknowns(×10) → … (bracketing every 15)
ada:dwellTimeDefault: 0.02 s per isotope; 100 samples per peak; 10 runs; 60 passes; total measurement time 120 s per analysis
ada:backgroundCountTimeDefault: 20 s background measurement (laser shutter closed) before each 40 s ablation
ada:internalStandardApproach: Fe+Ni+Co sum normalization to 100% using iolite 3D Trace Elements DRS (eliminates need for independent EPMA IS)
ada:internalStandardElement: No single IS; Fe+Ni+Co mass fractions normalized to 100% via iolite 3D DRS (yield correction factors applied for NIST SRM 612 relative to North Chile)
ada:elementalFractionationCorrection: External calibration using North Chile iron meteorite + NIST SRM 612 glass (yield correction applied in iolite 3D DRS for NIST relative to North Chile); ordinary least-squares fitting per 15 min calibration block; Fe+Ni+Co normalization eliminates need for independent EPMA IS
ada:signalIntegrationIntervalMethod: Time-resolved LA-ICP-MS signals inspected per analysis; background interval (20 s) and ablation interval (40 s) selected; no automated spike exclusion described
ada:blankBackgroundCorrectionMethod: Background signal measured for 20 s (laser shutter closed) before each 40 s ablation; background mean subtracted per isotope in iolite
ada:isobaricInterferenceCorrection: Yes — isotope selection to minimize interferences (e.g., ⁹⁹Ru instead of ¹⁰¹Ru to avoid ⁴⁰Ar⁶¹Ni⁺; low abundance isotopes for Fe and Ni)
ada:interferingSpecies: ⁴⁰Ar⁶¹Ni⁺ on ¹⁰¹Ru (primary concern) → ⁹⁹Ru used instead; Fe and Ni matrix species on other isotopes minimized by isotope selection
ada:isobaricInterferenceCorrectionMethod: Isotope selection minimizes interferences; low-abundance isotopes of Fe and Ni chosen for analog mode to prevent detector saturation
ada:secondaryReferenceMaterialDefault: North Chile Filomena measured as unknown on different days over 4 months to assess intermediate precision (Table 3 and Fig. 2)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Plasma / Make-up Gas Addition
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: Ar make-up gas (combined via T-piece in sample transport line near torch; flow rate not stated separately)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: ICP Tuning
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: ICP and laser settings optimized daily for optimum signal intensity and low oxide formation (factory specifications; mass calibration and detector cross-calibration checked and redone if required)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Normalization / Standards-Based Correction
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: Fe+Ni+Co=100% sum normalization applied in iolite 3D Trace Elements DRS as final step; yield correction factors applied for NIST SRM 612 relative to North Chile

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Multi-Run Sequential Analysis Design
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Single acquisition run (20 spot analyses per sample under repeatability conditions)

ada:analyteColumns.schema:name: Analyzed constituent
ada:analyteColumns.schema:description: Analyzed constituent (isotope) identified by the analyte row.

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Pulse/Analog Detector Nonlinearity Correction
schema:additionalProperty.schema:defaultValue: Applied: triple mode detector (pulse counting, analog, Faraday); low relative abundance isotopes chosen for Ni and Fe to allow analog mode measurement of major matrix elements

ada:primaryStandardNameDefault: NIST SRM 612 glass (Jochum et al. 2011) + North Chile Filomena iron meteorite (Wasson et al. 1989) — used together with yield correction in iolite 3D DRS
ada:calibrationMeasurementFrequency: NIST SRM 612 and North Chile measured bracketing every 15 unknowns: 3×STD → 3×STD → 10×unknowns → repeat
